title: Best AI ticketing systems for customer support in 2026, compared
summary: An AI ticketing system is a help desk where agents answer, route, summarize, and act on customer issues, and your team reviews the exceptions.
body_markdown:
For B2B teams that support customers in Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email, Pylon ties each issue to the customer account, and agents investigate issues before your team opens them. Zendesk, Intercom (now Fin), Freshdesk, Help Scout, and Salesforce Service Cloud fit other setups, compared below.


## Which AI ticketing systems should you compare in 2026?


Platform Best for AI, as each vendor describes it AI pricing model


Pylon B2B support in Slack, Teams, email, and chat Support Agent, Assist Agent, Slack Agent, Automations, Skills, and MCP server Seats plus agentic credits. No per-issue fees.


Zendesk High-volume help desks AI agents included on plans. Copilot is an add-on on Suite Professional, included in Suite Enterprise + Copilot, and not available on Suite Team. Automated resolutions beyond an included amount


Intercom In-app and product-led support Fin AI Agent. Copilot is an add-on, billed per agent. Fin can run on other help desks. Fin billed per outcome


Freshdesk Growing teams on a budget Freddy AI Agent, Freddy AI Copilot (Pro and Enterprise only), and Freddy AI Insights AI Agent sessions included on some plans. Copilot billed per agent.


Help Scout Small teams that want a simple inbox AI Answers for customers, plus Inbox Assistant (AI Drafts, AI Summarize, and AI Assist) for the team AI Answers billed per resolution


Salesforce Service Cloud Support on Salesforce CRM records Agentforce See Salesforce pricing


*Prices change often, so the table lists pricing models only.*


## What should an AI ticketing system do?


- Answer routine questions from your knowledge base, and hand off to a person with the full context.
- Summarize long threads and draft replies for your team.
- Route issues and set fields automatically.
- Take action, such as linking a Jira or Linear issue or updating a CRM field.
- Report how often agents resolve issues and how often they hand off.
- Let your own AI tools in through an API or MCP server.


## Pylon: best for B2B teams


Pylon's agents work from account context, so answers reflect the customer's plan, history, and open issues:


- Support Agent resolves the simple questions, does the first pass on the complex ones, and brings in a person when judgment is needed.
- Assist Agent investigates and acts for your team.
- Slack Agent lets sales, success, product, and engineering ask agents questions and take action from Slack.


Skills teach agents your process, and Automations trigger work from events. The MCP server is on every plan. AssemblyAI cut in-app chat first response time 97%, from 15 minutes to 23 seconds. Pylon prices per seat on an annual contract, plus agentic credits for agents, and current plans are on the[pricing page](https://www.usepylon.com/pricing) .


## Zendesk: best for high-volume help desks


Zendesk is a ticketing platform with AI agents, copilot, procedures, and automation. AI agents are included on its plans and billed by automated resolution beyond an included amount. Copilot is an add-on on Suite Professional, included in Suite Enterprise + Copilot, and not available on Suite Team.


## Intercom: best for in-app and product-led support


Intercom's Fin AI Agent is billed per outcome and can run on top of other help desks. Copilot is an add-on, billed per agent. Intercom also publishes an MCP server. Fin, formerly Intercom, has been part of Salesforce since September 2026.


## Freshdesk: best for growing teams on a budget


Freshdesk's AI includes Freddy AI Agent for customer answers, Freddy AI Copilot for agent assistance, and Freddy AI Insights for reporting. Freddy AI Copilot is a per-agent add-on, available on Pro and Enterprise only.


## Help Scout: best for small teams


Help Scout's customer-facing bot is AI Answers, billed per resolution. For the team, Help Scout groups AI Drafts, AI Summarize, and AI Assist under the name Inbox Assistant. It labels AI-generated replies to customers as AI.


## Salesforce Service Cloud: best for support on Salesforce records


Service Cloud's AI layer is Agentforce, built for teams that run support on Salesforce CRM data.


## How do you choose?


1. Match the platform to your customers: B2B accounts or high-volume B2C requests.
2. Check native channels against where customers reach you.
3. Pilot agents on real past issues.
4. Model cost at next year's volume under each pricing model.


## FAQ


### What's the best AI ticketing system for B2B?


For B2B teams that support customers in Slack, Teams, and email, Pylon is built for account-based support with agents.


### How is AI ticketing priced?


Most charge per seat plus usage for AI. Zendesk, Intercom, and Help Scout bill AI per resolution or outcome, Freshdesk bills its AI Agent by session, and Pylon bills agents with agentic credits instead of per issue.


### Does Zendesk use Einstein AI?


No. Einstein is a Salesforce brand. Zendesk offers AI agents and Copilot. Copilot is an add-on on Suite Professional, included in Suite Enterprise + Copilot, and not available on Suite Team.


### Can AI run on my existing help desk?


Some products, like Intercom Fin, run on other help desks. Pylon is a full help desk.
